# Yukings Noise Barrier Website Overview
# Domain: www.yukings.net
# Language: English

## Company Overview
Shenzhen Yukings Industrial Co., Ltd. is a professional noise barrier, sound barrier and acoustic barrier manufacturer based in Shenzhen, China. Established in 2006, with 18+ years OEM experience, 42,000 m² factory, ISO 9001/14001/45001 and CE certified. Exporting to 60+ countries.

## Core Product Categories
1. Railway Noise Barriers - High-speed rail noise barriers for metro lines, commuter rail and freight corridors (20-45 dB)
2. Highway Noise Barriers - Heavy-duty noise walls for highways, expressways (20-42 dB)
3. Solar Noise Barriers - PV-integrated sound barriers generating clean energy while reducing noise (25-35 dB)
4. Industrial Noise Barriers - Acoustic enclosures and plant perimeter noise barriers (25-45 dB)
5. Residential Noise Barriers - Aesthetic noise fences for communities (15-35 dB)

## Material Types
- Galvanized Steel Noise Barriers
- Aluminum Noise Barriers
- Transparent PC/Acrylic Noise Barriers
- Concrete Noise Barriers
- Micro-perforated Aluminum Noise Fences

## Key Specifications
- Max Insertion Loss: Up to 45 dB (DL, 200 Hz – 5 kHz)
- Design Lifespan: 25 years
- Warranty: 15 years structural warranty
- IP Rating: IP65-IP66
- Certifications: CE (EN 1793/EN 1794), ISO 9001/14001/45001
